### Do You Know About God’s Numerical Symbolism?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-16-2023.html
Passage: Revelation 13:18
Points:
- God established intentional mathematical and numerical order throughout all of physical creation.
- From planetary movements to human genetics, natural order reveals deliberate divine design rather than coincidence.
- Scripture also employs numerical symbolism to communicate spiritual truth and meaning.
- The structural consistency of numbers in the Bible reinforces confidence in its divine inspiration.
- Believers are invited to discern biblical numbers through the lens of God's wisdom and order.

### Don’t Fear the Marks in Revelation
Author: Jen Wilkin
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/fear-marks-revelation/
Passage: Revelation 13:16-17
Points:
- End-times depictions of the mark of the beast often cause Christians unnecessary terror and anxiety.
- The beast’s mark on the hand or forehead is a demonic parody of God sealing His people.
- In Revelation, marks designate ownership, showing who belongs to the beast and who belongs to God.
- Christians are already permanently sealed and secured for eternity by the Holy Spirit.
- Bearing the name of the Lord should inspire believers to live in daily holiness rather than dread.
